items.rationale: The model keeps nothing between calls; it only uses the tokens in the request. Memory across sessions has to be saved by the program and loaded back. Option a or d shows M1 (the model remembers by itself); option c shows M2 (a bigger window is memory across sessions).
Each call resends everything so far: 1,000 + 1,500 + 2,000 + 2,500 = 7,000. An answer of 2,500 counts only the final context; an answer of 2,000 or 4,000 adds only the new tokens.
Everything in the window is resent and billed on every call, and accuracy and recall can degrade as the window fills (context rot). Retrieval keeps the window small.
Compaction summarizes a near-full conversation and starts a new window with the summary.
